rule: The highest cutoff on the selected model's out-of-fold predicted risks (training rows only) that still flags at least 80% of the training cases. The highest such cutoff flags the fewest people, so it is the cheapest way to meet the target. Fixed before any test row is read.
calibration_rule: Recalibrate (Platt scaling: a logistic regression of the outcome on the model's out-of-fold log-odds) only if the calibration slope is outside 0.9-1.1 or the calibration-in-the-large intercept is further than 0.1 from 0. Recalibration is monotone, so it never changes who is flagged, only the risk a person is told.

ada_checklist.rule: 5 or more checklist points (the paper test's cutoff)

logistic_regression.rule: The highest cutoff on the reference model's out-of-fold predicted risks (training rows only) that still flags at least 80% of the training cases. The highest such cutoff flags the fewest people, so it is the cheapest way to meet the target. Fixed before any test row is read.
